status: GDI acceptance passed; full Wine acceptance still FAIL
changes: API9 GetDC uses absolute SYSTEM32 ddraw.dll only to allocate CPU/GDI memory surfaces with native XP DIBSECTION metadata. No 3D device, draw or presentation is delegated; API8 keeps the previous DIB path.
Row-wise actual pixel copies preserve source and destination pitches. Close releases DC, surface, DirectDraw owner and module; texture/cube destruction also disposes outstanding GDI resources.
limitations: Requires the installed Windows DirectDraw runtime for API9 GDI memory surfaces; self-module/loading failure is rejected and does not recurse.
